news.analysis: Ward had a decent game, all things considered. He now has four touchdown passes in the last two weeks, as many as he had in the previous seven games. His rushing production is also a welcome sight, going for 80 total rushing yards in that same two-game span. He had 71 total rushing yards in his first seven games. He certainly seems to have turned a corner these last two games; here's to hoping they can build some momentum and that this lasts.
news.contents: Cam Ward completed 28 of 39 passes for 231 yards, two touchdowns and a pick in the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also ran three times for 39 yards.
